title: Deep Learning Based Relative Transfer Matrix Estimation for Multiple Sources and Multiple Microphones
abstract: arXiv:2608.11627v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The Relative Transfer Matrix (ReTM), recently introduced as a generalization of the relative transfer function for multiple receivers and sources, shows promising performance when applied to speech enhancement in noisy environments. Estimating the ReTM of sound sources by exploiting the covariance matrices of multichannel recordings is highly beneficial for practical applications and, to date, remains the only proposed approach. This paper investigates deep learning-based ReTM estimation. We propose three novel supervised learning frameworks using time and short-time frequency transform domain convolutional networks, and a Long Short-Term Memory-based recurrent neural network. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed models achieve more accurate estimation of the ReTM using five objective metrics compared to the covariance-based method. translated_title: 基于深度学习的多声源多麦克风相对传递矩阵估计
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.11627v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：相对传递矩阵（ReTM）作为多接收器和多声源的相对传递函数的推广，近年来被引入，在嘈杂环境下的语音增强应用中显示出良好的性能。通过利用多通道记录的协方差矩阵来估计声源的ReTM，对实际应用非常有益，且迄今为止，这仍是唯一提出的方法。本文研究了基于深度学习的ReTM估计。我们提出了三种新颖的监督学习框架，使用时间和短时频率变换域卷积网络，以及基于长短期记忆的递归神经网络。实验结果表明，与基于协方差的方法相比，所提出的模型在五项客观指标上实现了更准确的ReTM估计。我们还展示了所提框架在语音增强中的有效性，取得了显著改进。
tldr: 本文首次提出基于深度学习的相对传递矩阵估计方法，通过三种监督学习框架（时域和频域卷积网络及LSTM循环网络）在多个客观指标上优于传统协方差方法，并有效提升了语音增强性能。
en_tdlr: This paper pioneers deep learning-based Relative Transfer Matrix estimation, proposing three supervised frameworks (time/frequency-domain CNNs and LSTM) that outperform covariance-based methods across five metrics and enhance speech enhancement performance.
